title: Reliable Sign-In, Fast Account Switching & Delete Account Fixes
releaseNotes: Made logging out instant while preserving per-account backups so switching back or working offline stays seamless.
Fixed Delete Account & Cloud Data to reliably clear cloud and local records without hanging.
Prevented duplicate accounts and repeated age/gender prompts when signing back in, rolled back failed logins cleanly, and added an All Shifts toggle on DC Bus routes.
